_doc: OWN-DB-1 (Q-GAP-core-separation): the core's databases, the tenant databases the core never binds, and the live reading this rests on. Checked by `python3 -m foundation owndb --check` (checks.yml) and `--live` (rule own-database in doctrine/rules.json); `bound_by` is written by `owndb --write`. The originating fleet's database ids are the forbidden patterns of doctrine/single-account.json.

core.name: ultrastable-org
core.binding: ORG on the site Worker, DB on the tick Worker
core.holds: the organization: items, claims, predictions, outcomes, goals, trust ledger, audit log, handoffs

core.name: ultrastable-ops
core.binding: DB on the site, dashboard and agents Workers
core.holds: operations: first-party analytics, owner sign-in, provenance, transparency, and the shared data of built sites (site_data)

core.name: ultrastable-unlearn
core.binding: DB on the ultrastable-unlearn Worker only
core.holds: the Unlearn tenant app (instances/unlearn): explorations, coach notes, move weights, beats; no child personal data in phases 1 and 2

core.name: ultrastable-what-works
core.binding: DB on the ultrastable-what-works Worker only
core.holds: the What Works tenant app (ultrastable/what-works): citation checks, leads, grades, grade changes, anonymous guess counts, beats; no personal data

core.name: ultrastable-replication-ledger
core.binding: DB on the ultrastable-replication-ledger Worker only
core.holds: Replication Ledger tenant: discovered findings, machine-read attempts, leads, retraction flags, Crossref checks, standing changes, beats (instances/replication-ledger); created 2026-11-25

declared_not_present.name: ultrastable-spinoffs
declared_not_present.finding: the config names a database and a Worker (ultrastable-spinoffs) that the 2026-11-20 reading of the account does not contain; nothing in this account binds it (docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md, 2026-11-18, places that Worker in the retired account)

live.method: Cloudflare API, D1 database list and sqlite_master of both core databases, read from the cloud session that wrote this record

databases.name: ultrastable-unlearn
databases.note: created that minute through the Cloudflare API from the cloud session; tables are created by the Worker on first request

databases.name: ultrastable-what-works
databases.note: created through the Cloudflare API from the cloud session; tables are created by the Worker on its first beat

databases.name: ultrastable-replication-ledger
databases.note: id from doctrine/topology.json, which records it from the Cloudflare API at creation; owndb --live confirms it against the account; tables are created by the Worker

live.finding: the account holds five databases; the two core databases are bound only by core Workers, each tenant has its own database, and no database of the originating fleet is in the account
